scope: Technical checks do not certify human grading, commit, repository accessibility or class submission.

checks.check: Frozen corpus, benchmark, config and retrieval code SHA256
At least 30 independent source units >=1500 characters
No identical normalized source units
All chunks preserve exact source offsets and cover every non-whitespace character
Raw/normalized source SHA256, sizes, boundaries and license attribution
15 dev / 5 test and >=3 filters including test
Every gold quote appears on exact declared source/page
Published split lists exactly match benchmark records
Complete 60 unique query/strategy traces, three hits each
Hit definitions, all 180 source spans/metadata and C filters
Saved split summaries agree with traces
B and C chunks exactly identical
B/C retrieval identical on every unfiltered question
Selection retains frozen inputs and records no test metrics used
Selection timestamp precedes test-phase run
Actual upsert twice preserved all collection counts
Actual persistent store reopened
30 coherence, 15 grounding, 45 metadata reviewed records
Every subjective label has actual reviewer/reason/valid score
Coherence labels use exactly the same ten preregistered source positions
Grounding judgments identify all three actual test chunks
Versioned evidence review binds exact baseline input hashes
All 180 reviewed hits have bound material, criteria and single-chunk decisions
Reviewed metrics use same ranked chunks and one complete chunk per hit
Real isolated replay matches baseline retrieval and preserves its files
Executed pipeline/review tests succeeded with no skipped tests
Replayed embedding model files match the pinned snapshot manifest
Original rubric, rules, guides, benchmark and report template unchanged
Required named report and experiment log exist
